preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_j <= n and 1 <= a_j <= 10**9 and 1 <= b_j <= 10**9 for p_j, a_j, b_j in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must have valid ancestor and cost values within specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n-1 integers for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= r_i <= n - 1 for r_i in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each output integer r_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(r_i == max_prefix_length for r_i, max_prefix_length in zip(map(int, stdout.split()), max_prefix_lengths))
postconditions.description: Each output integer r_i must match the calculated maximum prefix length for the corresponding vertex.
